summary: Expo SDK 58 upgrade regression smoke (frontend only, web preview, 375x667). The upgrade caused one CRITICAL regression: in expo-router 58, Tabs.Screen `href: null` now maps to `hidden: true` (node_modules/expo-router/build/layouts/TabsClient.js:91-98, 'new redirect behavior'). Hidden routes can no longer be opened at all. Before my fix, the seller Add-Item wizard, New Drop, Payouts and Payout account screens could not be reached: router.push and deep links both bounced back to Inventory with no console error. Courier job/[id] uses the same pattern. I applied a small compat fix: `href: null` became `tabBarButton: () => null, tabBarItemStyle: { display: 'none' }` in app/(seller)/_layout.tsx and app/(courier)/_layout.tsx. After the fix, add-item steps 1, 2 and 3 render and the prev/back buttons work, /payouts and /payout-account open, and the seller tab bar still shows exactly 4 tabs. Everything else passed with zero console errors or page errors: the landing page renders the OROMONA hero, buyer registration lands on /onboarding/measurements, buyer logout and re-login with the buyer chip work, the Discover/Try On/Atelier/Profile tabs load, item detail renders for 2 items and its back button returns to Discover, seller registration and login with the Selling chip work, the seller Inventory/Analytics/Orders/Settings tabs load, seller sign-out works, and admin login reaches the /admin dashboard with analytics and all 6 admin tabs. No 'Unmatched Route' was seen anywhere. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: The horizontal category chip ScrollView (TOPS/BOTTOMS/OUTERWEAR...) is squashed to about 11px tall even though its style says height:56, because the ScrollView has flexShrink:1. The chip labels get clipped and the 'Set my size' card overlaps them, on both mobile and tablet. This may be caused by the RN 0.88 / react-native-web 0.21.4 bump, but that is not confirmed. Fix: add flexGrow:0 and flexShrink:0 to styles.row in src/components/ChipsRow.tsx.

PRE-EXISTING, not caused by the upgrade. The 'Gross revenue (paid)' value uses tp.h1 (color rgb(10,10,10)) on the styles.revenue background colors.primary (rgb(10,10,10)), so the number is invisible. Reference: app/admin/index.tsx:116 and :221. Give the value a light color (for example colors.primaryFg).

context_for_next_testing_agent: SDK 58 / expo-router 58: Tabs `href: null` means hidden, and hidden routes cannot be navigated to. Use tabBarButton: () => null instead. Seller login needs the login-intent-seller chip. After the upgrade, Tab screens stay mounted in the DOM, so body innerText includes content from inactive tabs. Use testIDs, not body text. Image upload in the add-item wizard works with page.expect_file_chooser on wizard-photo-add-library.
rca_of_issue: Repro before the fix: log in as a seller, tap inventory-add-btn, and the URL stays at '/'. Navigating directly to /add-item, /new-collection or /payouts also redirects to '/'. Root cause: expo-router 58.0.28 TabsClient.processScreens turns href===null into options.hidden=true (comment: 'Update the hiding-a-tab guide for the new redirect behavior'), so the navigator refuses to focus hidden routes. Mitigation: hide the tab button with tabBarButton: () => null (and tabBarItemStyle display:none) so the route stays navigable. Verified: the wizard opens at /add-item and steps 1→2→3 work.
